description: Rochester, NY – Today, the International Union of Bricklayers and Allied Craftworkers Local 3 has endorsed Joe Morelle in the race for the for the 25th Congressional District. Local 3 represents thousands of trowel trades craft workers and is the 9th union endorsement Morelle has received.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY JOE MORELLE FOR CONGRESS bottom of page
title: Bricklayers Endorse Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
